PLAN "12-Week Plant-Powered Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary hypertrophy:
    name "Build muscle on plant-based nutrition (150g protein/day)"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Push":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 1m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Lower":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          leg_swings 1m
          hip_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12..15 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          scapular_retraction 1m
          prone_Y 1m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds

          lat_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower + Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m

          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
